findings.text: The head commit relabels the table column to 'changed mask entries' and the prose to a changed-entry count, but the cells still carry boundary_set_size populations: trip-trajectory/trajectory-rows.json has no changed_mask_cells key on any row (keys are boundary_set_size and promotion_step_norm_wb only), and the values 27/39/0 and 24/20/9/9/0 match boundary_set_size exactly. A reader is told the run measured mask churn when it measured set populations, which is the opposite claim for frame 146 (populations 27->39 look like growth; changed entries at 39 would look like a large single-trip edit).

The sentence '27, then 1, then 39 in the changed count it reports' contradicts the table directly above it, which reads 27, 39, 0; the '1' is the trip-3 boundary_set_size of a later row and the ordering is not chronological.

done_when item 3 requires a line-contour panel of each trip that matters carrying the real DIII-D limiter, both null sets, the bounding surface from host_boundary_read and the EFIT boundary; the fragment carries no panel per trip, only the terminal-state figures, and the manifest concedes the substitution under rubric.record.
